$$\frac{1}{(2\pi)^n}\lim_{\epsilon\to 0}\sum_{z\in\mathbb Z^n}\epsilon^n\,e^{-i(z\epsilon)\cdot a}\,\hat f(-z\epsilon).$$

$$\sum_{z\in\mathbb Z^n}\epsilon^n\,g(z\epsilon)=\epsilon^n\sum_{z\in\mathbb Z^n}g(z\epsilon).$$
